name: CASEpeer
description: CASEpeer is cloud personal-injury case-management software for intake, cases, client communication, deadlines, calendars, documents, reports, billing workflows, and firm operations.
agentUseSummary: CASEpeer is visible as a preview-only Marketplace entry. CASEpeer's first-party support article states that CASEpeer does not currently offer an open API; public product and integration materials describe partner integrations, Zapier, calendar/document/payment/accounting integrations, and nightly data sync for CASEpeer Advanced, but do not publish the authorization model, base URL, scopes, endpoints, rate limits, partner enrollment, or production acceptance contract Relay needs for a direct connector. Relay will not use Zapier, nightly sync, partner integrations, browser sessions, credentials, or provider consoles as a substitute for an approved CASEpeer API contract.

capabilities.label: Coordinate personal-injury case operations
capabilities.description: Preview a future provider-approved, exact-firm-authorized, least-privilege integration surface without assuming access to identity, client, case, medical, document, communication, billing, or reporting records.

blocked.label: Connect without a CASEpeer API contract
blocked.description: Relay will not accept or mint credentials until CASEpeer supplies or approves the exact public or partner API contract, authorization model, production and test origins, scopes or permissions, tenant binding, token lifecycle, rate limits, audit requirements, and live acceptance process.

blocked.label: Access identity, client, case, or medical records
blocked.description: Users, firms, roles, clients, leads, cases, case status, medical providers, medical records, treatment data, settlements, custom fields, tags, and related personal-injury legal-practice records remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Access documents, calendars, communications, or financial data
blocked.description: Documents, folders, deadlines, calendar events, texts, emails, client portal content, notes, tasks, reports, KPIs, costs, invoices, payments, trust or accounting integrations, and financial records remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use Zapier, sync exports, UI sessions, or partner integrations
blocked.description: Zapier triggers/actions, nightly data sync, third-party integration paths, provider consoles, browser sessions, cookies, passwords, traffic capture, scraping, reverse engineering, arbitrary endpoints, raw responses, pagination, polling, bulk operations, exports, writes, and administration are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Provider and firm review required
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is callable until CASEpeer supplies or approves the public or partner API and production integration contract, and the exact law firm authorizes a least-privilege connection.

runtimeSupport.description: CASEpeer remains visible for discovery, but no OpenClaw tools are callable before CASEpeer approval, exact-firm authorization, least-privilege design review, and live acceptance.
CASEpeer remains visible for discovery, but no Hermes tools are callable before CASEpeer approval, exact-firm authorization, least-privilege design review, and live acceptance.

providerSetup.blocker: CASEpeer's first-party support states that CASEpeer does not currently offer an open API. Public integrations, Zapier, and nightly sync materials do not provide the complete third-party API contract Relay requires for implementation.
providerSetup.nextAction: Ask CASEpeer to approve Relay and provide the current public or partner API contract, production and test origins, authorization and callback model, scopes or tenant permissions, token lifecycle, rate limits, audit and privacy obligations, test tenant, and live acceptance process. Then obtain explicit authorization from the exact law firm and approve a least-privilege action/data classification before implementing any connector.

evidence.supports: CASEpeer support states that CASEpeer does not currently offer an open API and points users to Zapier and nightly data sync with CASEpeer Advanced instead.

CASEpeer lists many product and partner integrations, including calendar, document, lead, communication, payment, accounting, AI, reporting, and Zapier integrations, but not a public Relay-callable API contract.

CASEpeer describes Zapier triggers and actions for status changes, new leads, incoming texts, communications, and task workflows, which Relay treats as third-party automation rather than direct CASEpeer API access.

CASEpeer describes personal-injury practice-management scope including client portals, intake, texts, emails, status updates, files, calendar integrations, document cloud management, financial functions, and reports.

securityNotes: No CASEpeer account, API key, token, firm identifier, client, case, medical, document, payment, accounting, report, communication, or legal-practice data was collected or tested.

A partner network, Zapier app, third-party integrations, or nightly data sync does not establish Relay authorization, a distributable authentication flow, exact tenant binding, least-privilege scopes, or production acceptance.

Relay will not use browser sessions, passwords, cookies, provider consoles, Zapier, nightly sync exports, partner integrations, traffic capture, scraping, or reverse engineering as a substitute for a CASEpeer API contract.

All identity, client, lead, case, medical, document, calendar, task, communication, billing, payment, trust, accounting, reporting, write, administration, raw API, pagination, bulk, and export operations remain unavailable.
